name: 42646-fixed1k1k-gemma3-27b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2, NVLink/NVSwitch).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1 (~54 GB of bf16 weights, ~27 GB per card, leaving most of each card for KV).
architecture: Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~27B params, text-only prompts here; layer shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json (text_config).
workload: single-turn synthetic text generation, fixed 1024 prompt tokens in and 1024 output tokens out, 512 requests, greedy (temperature 0.0), static seed 42646; no prefix reuse, no multi-turn, no images. Driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend rather than over a served endpoint.
purpose: A 27-billion-parameter assistant drafting page-length replies to page-length prompts for 64 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
model: unsloth/gemma-3-27b-it

tensor-parallel-size: 2
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

optimization-level: 2
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 6144

# PINNED as an ADMISSION GATE, not as a sizing choice. This engine's own default is 0.92, and
# `v1/worker/utils.py: request_memory` REFUSES TO START when free memory is below util x total --
# 0.92 x 79.19 = 72.85 GiB on an H100 80GB. Measured on this node with `reap: GPU 0,1 clean`, a
# pristine card reports only 69.78-72.34 GiB free (CUDA context and NCCL buffers take the rest),
# so the gate is unsatisfiable even with no co-tenant: 24 refusals and a cascade of half-dead TP
# workers that then block the retries. 0.82 asks 64.94 GiB and leaves ~5 GiB of tolerance.
#
# It does NOT move the operating point. Available KV = util x total - non-KV, which never reads
# foreign residency, so a pinned util is the only way to give every run a byte-identical pool.
# Per rank at TP=2 that pool is ~36.8 GiB (64.94 - 25.1 of weights - ~3 of
# activations/graphs/workspace) against a worst case of ~21.0 GiB for this workload (64 seqs x
# 2048 ctx; 10 full-attention layers at 40,960 B/token plus 52 sliding-window layers bounded at
# ~1152 tokens, 4096 B/token/layer per rank) -- 1.75x headroom, so no request is ever preempted
# at either 0.82 or the 0.92 default.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.82
